sloka: त्वां पुरा चीरवसनं प्रविशन्तं महावनम् ।स्त्रीतृतीयं च्युतं राज्याद्धर्मकामं च केवलम् ।पदातिं त्यक्तसर्वस्वं पितुर्वचनकारिणम् ।। ६.१२७.५ ।।
transliteration: tvāṁ purā cīravasanaṁ praviśantaṁ mahāvanam ।strītṛtīyaṁ cyutaṁ rājyāddharmakāmaṁ ca kevalam ।padātiṁ tyaktasarvasvaṁ piturvacanakāriṇam ।। 6.127.5 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! You, who are victorious in winning enemies, have earlier on account of father's words, intent on following father's words, accepting Kaikeyi's words, went with Lakshmana and Sita, clad in bark clothes, giving up kingdom and all possessions, like heaven set out on foot and entered huge forest, living on roots and fruits of the forest. Seeing you, compassion arose in me."
translations.hindi: , हे वीर ! तुम ऐसी अनुचित, कर्णकडु और रूखी बातें उस तरह क्यों कहते हो, जिस तरह गंवार आदमी अपनी गवार सनी से कहा करते हैं
